translations.zh: 靜皇帝諱衍，後改為闡，宣帝長子也。
translations.literal: Emperor Jing's taboo name was Yan; later it was changed to Chan; he was Emperor Xuan's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing, taboo name Yan, later changed to Chan, was Emperor Xuan's eldest son.

translations.zh: 建德二年六月，生於東宮。
translations.literal: In the sixth month of Jiande year two he was born in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Jiande year two he was born in the Eastern Palace.

translations.zh: 大象元年正月癸卯，封魯王。
translations.literal: In the first month of Daxiang year one, on guimao day, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Daxiang year one, on guimao day, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Lu.

translations.literal: On wuwu day he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day he was installed as crown prince.

translations.zh: 二月辛巳，宣帝於鄴宮傳位授帝，居正陽宮。
translations.literal: In the second month, on xinsi day, Emperor Xuan at Ye palace transmitted the throne to the emperor, who dwelt in Zhengyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinsi day, Emperor Xuan at Ye palace transmitted the throne to Emperor Jing, who took residence at Zhengyang Palace.
